claim: The six-scenario LEAN historical-simulation replay ran twice (independent fresh processes) on lean-985ef30-r20260925 after this fix round resolved the dotnet build blocker (see lean.json). Both runs exited 0. Every economic/behavioral field this track was asked to compare -- native_end_equity_usd, fees, dividends, fill/margin-call counts, and max_observed_drawdown to full decimal precision, plus the full order/intent/margin-call/audit ledgers -- matched the frozen 2026-09-19 oracle exactly, for both runs. Of the 24 recorded artifact hashes, 12 (events_sha256, audit_sha256 for all 6 cases) matched the oracle and each other exactly; the other 12 (summary_sha256, native_result_sha256) did not, because those two files embed a wall-clock StartTime/EndTime, a 'Used RAM (MB)' measurement, and one generated GUID -- confirmed by diffing the two fresh runs' underlying JSON, which differ in nothing else at all.

oracle_comparison.method: Deep structural diff of each run's full results.json (every intent, fill, margin call, reduction, and the max_observed_drawdown/max_observed_gross Decimal strings to full precision) against the frozen receipt.json table above, plus a byte-for-byte comparison of all 24 recorded hashes.
oracle_comparison.exact_field_result: 0 mismatches across all 6 cases, both runs, against the frozen oracle: every field in frozen_oracle_exact_fields reproduced exactly.
oracle_comparison.hash_result: 12 of 24 hashes matched exactly (events_sha256, audit_sha256 for all 6 cases, both runs, and the 2026-09-19 oracle). The other 12 (summary_sha256, native_result_sha256) did not match the oracle and also differed between run-1 and run-2 on this same root.
oracle_comparison.hash_mismatch_root_cause: A full structural diff of run-1 vs run-2's results.json found exactly 12 differing leaves -- precisely those 12 hash fields and nothing else (every economic/behavioral field, to full Decimal-string precision, was byte-identical between the two independent runs). Directly diffing the underlying files showed the only differences are HistoricalSimulationAlgorithm-summary.json's/HistoricalSimulationAlgorithm.json's own 'StartTime', 'EndTime', 'Used RAM (MB)' fields (wall-clock/runtime measurements LEAN writes into its own result files) plus one generated GUID in the full result JSON. This is the same category of field the equity-replay track's frozen oracle explicitly excludes from reoccurrence claims ('Generated identities are not claimed to repeat'); LEAN's summary/result files were not previously known to embed wall-clock fields, so this receipt records the finding rather than assuming a byte-for-byte match.
oracle_comparison.result: The six-scenario replay is accepted as matching its oracle on every economic/behavioral field with 0 mismatches; the 12/24 hash mismatches are attributed to specific, identified, non-economic fields (not a silent partial match).
